title: ANGER
author: Neha Bhandarkar
text:
Anger, anger, go away
You burn in your own way
You live in a house of hatred
In every eye, I find fear
you are not sacred

You can`t be diagnosed
with a problem
You are not a solution
In fact, you are the cause
of all mental pollution

You are an impolite interpreter
You are a mind destroyer
You are a burning cigar
Who spoils beauty
leaving behind a scar
You are, at times a reason for
catastrophic effects like war

You mislead and stray and stray
You set fires upon fires
never apologizing to your prey

Hey anger, you need no permission
when you get out of control
There is no limitation
You are such a devious one
So retire already and be done!
